articles.summary: LOS ANGELES, May 30, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- AXIL Brands, Inc. (“AXIL” or the “Company”)(NYSE American: AXIL), a leader in innovative hearing protection, hearing enhancement, and wireless technology, is proud to announce its recent recognition in esteemed military and technology media outlets. Renowned publications including Military Times, Marine Corps Times, Air Force Times and Navy Times spotlighted AXIL’s groundbreaking products in a series of articles. Additionally, the article was syndicated with Yahoo Tech.
articles.title: AXIL Brands, Inc. Receives Prestigious Features in Leading Military Publications
